checks.criterion: Unauthenticated visitor at / must be redirected to /login, never a dead-end 'Session ended' screen.
checks.name: unauth-root-redirects-login
checks.evidence: Cleared cookies, navigated to /, landed on /login with login form visible; body text did not contain 'Session ended'. Screenshot: unauth-root-redirects-login-login-page.png

checks.criterion: Unauthenticated deep links (/dashboard, /assets, /queue, /campaigns, /audit, /admin) are guarded, not dead-ended.
checks.name: unauth-deeplinks-redirect-login
checks.evidence: Each of the 6 protected routes redirected to /login with the login form visible and no 'Session ended' text. Screenshot: unauth-deeplinks-redirect-login-final-login.png

checks.criterion: Login works and lands the user on their role dashboard.
checks.name: login-lands-on-dashboard
checks.evidence: Signed in as sales@ims.test via demo-account button, redirected to /dashboard, kpi-grid visible, sidebar-user-name shows 'Vikram Sales'. Screenshot: login-lands-on-dashboard-dashboard-after-login.png

checks.criterion: Session survives a full page reload (httpOnly cookie persists); already-authenticated user visiting /login is bounced to dashboard.
checks.name: session-reload-and-login-bounce
checks.evidence: After login, page.reload() kept kpi-grid visible and URL off /login, no 'Session ended' text. Subsequent navigation to /login while authenticated redirected back to /dashboard. Screenshots: after-reload.png, login-bounced-to-dashboard.png

checks.criterion: Signing out returns the user to login and re-protects the app.
checks.name: signout-blocks-protected-pages
checks.evidence: Clicked sign-out, landed on /login; subsequent navigation to /dashboard redirected to /login again with no stale data or 'Session ended' text. Screenshots: after-signout.png, dashboard-blocked-after-signout.png

checks.criterion: Role gating on the Admin area holds after the guard change.
checks.name: admin-area-role-gating
checks.evidence: sales@ims.test at /admin sees 'Admin access required' restricted message, no user list; admin@ims.test at /admin sees the user list including sales@ims.test entry. Screenshots: sales-admin-restricted.png, admin-user-list-visible.png

checks.criterion: Auth session lifecycle (login sets cookie, /auth/me works, logout clears it; bad password rejected) — API-level backing for the reload/logout browser criteria.
checks.name: test_tscheck_auth_session.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login (sales@ims.test) -> 200 sets ims_session cookie; GET /api/auth/me -> 200 {email, role: sales}; POST /api/auth/logout -> 200 with Set-Cookie Max-Age=0; GET /api/auth/me after cookie removal -> 401. POST /api/auth/login wrong password -> 401. 2 tests passed.

checks.criterion: Finance-manager confirmation flow / role-restricted API action (pre-existing backend coverage, unrelated to the auth-guard bug fix but part of repo's existing test suite).
checks.name: test_tscheck_fm_confirm_flow.py
checks.evidence: Full pytest run: 5 passed in 1.21s (includes this file alongside auth_session tests).

notes: 7 acceptance-matrix criteria covered by 6 browser checks + 2 backend test files (8 total artifacts); criteria 4 and 5 combined into one browser check (session-reload-and-login-bounce) since they share the same authenticated-session flow.
Console 401s on /api/auth/me observed during unauthenticated-page checks are expected/benign per briefing and were not counted as failures.
All checks and backend tests passed on this run; no bugs found in the guard-fix behavior under test.
